_doc: Kalshi lane parameters -- the ONLY place knobs live. Never hardcode these in code. Mirrors the params.json convention used by the SPY arms. Sized for the $10 seed account (2026-08-09); revisit every tier change.
label: KALSHI-1
_series_doc: Ordered preference. The lane ports the SPY 0DTE directional decision, so index series come first; it falls through to the next series when a gate blocks (e.g. spread too wide). KXINXU=S&P hourly, KXINX=S&P daily.
_gates_doc: Hard entry gates. Every one of these is a REFUSAL, not a preference. max_spread_cents is the C3 lesson (ITM+tight=edge, OTM+wide=bleed) ported to this venue: at 5c a maker needs ~2.5pp more edge than at 1c.
_sizing_doc: $10 account. max_stake is per-position notional. min_contracts guards the fee ceiling (1-contract orders pay ~14% over formula rate).
_risk_doc: Mirrors Safe-2 doctrine proportionally: -30% of start-of-day equity halts the day. On a $10 account that is $3.
_execution_doc: MAKER ONLY by design -- the economics model showed taking the spread costs 5-6x the maker fee. join_touch posts at the near touch rather than crossing. If unfilled, the tick simply re-evaluates next cycle; we never chase.
_gate_doc: Minimum Gamma conviction required to port a decision across. Mirrors the SPY score gate; a signal too weak to trade SPY is too weak to trade here.
_hours_doc: Index series only make sense while the underlying trades. ET. The lane self-gates outside this window for index series; 24/7 series (crypto) are exempt.
